definitions.gloss: possessiveness; desire to monopolize; jealous desire to have someone or something all to oneself
definitions.explanation: A strong desire to have exclusive possession of a person, thing, or resource. Most commonly used about romantic possessiveness, but can also apply to material things or attention.

examples.japanese: {独占欲|どくせんよく}が{強|つよ}い。
{恋人|こいびと}への{独占欲|どくせんよく}を{抑|おさ}えられない。
examples.english: I can't control my possessiveness toward my partner.

examples.japanese: {独占欲|どくせんよく}が{強|つよ}すぎると{人間関係|にんげんかんけい}がうまくいかなくなる。
examples.english: If you're too possessive, your relationships won't go well.

notes:
USAGE:
{独占欲|どくせんよく} is a compound of {独占|どくせん} (monopoly) and {欲|よく} (desire). In everyday conversation it most often refers to romantic jealousy and possessiveness, but it can also describe a desire to monopolize resources, attention, or opportunities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独占欲|どくせんよく}が{強|つよ}い (to be possessive)
- {独占欲|どくせんよく}を{抑|おさ}える (to control one's possessiveness)
- {独占欲|どくせんよく}にかられる (to be driven by possessiveness)
